steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
pwd
git status
echo "--- branches ---"
git branch -avv
echo "--- reflog ---"
git reflog --all | head -50
echo "--- log all ---"
git log --all --oneline --decorate --graph | head -60
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace
find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -name .git -print 2>/dev/null
find / -maxdepth 4 -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | head -50
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
git status
echo "--- branches ---"
git branch -avv
echo "--- reflog ---"
git reflog --all | head -80
echo "--- log all ---"
git log --all --oneline --decorate --graph | head -100
echo "--- stash ---"
git stash list
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- commit ---"
git show --stat --oneline --decorate 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
echo "--- parents/graph ---"
git log --oneline --decorate --graph --max-count=8 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
echo "--- diff master...commit ---"
git diff --stat master 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
echo "--- diff ---"
git diff master 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- master tip diff ---"
git show --stat --oneline d7d3e4b
git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff d7d3e4b -- _includes/about.md _layouts/default.html | head -120
echo "--- merge-base ---"
git merge-base master 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- c4e38a1 about ---"
git show c4e38a1:_includes/about.md
echo
echo "--- master about ---"
git show master:_includes/about.md
echo
echo "--- 650 about ---"
git show 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a:_includes/about.md
echo
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
set -e
git branch move-to-stanford 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
git merge --no-ff move-to-stanford -m "Merge branch 'move-to-stanford'" || true
echo "--- status after merge attempt ---"
git status
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
set -e
git config --get user.name || true
git config --get user.email || true
ls .git/MERGE_HEAD 2>/dev/null && echo "merge in progress" || echo "no merge in progress"
git config user.name "Mike Merrill"
git config user.email "mikeam@cs.washington.edu"
git merge --no-ff move-to-stanford -m "Merge branch 'move-to-stanford'" || true
echo "--- status ---"
git status
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
set -e
git checkout --theirs -- _includes/about.md
git add _includes/about.md
echo "--- resolved about.md ---"
cat _includes/about.md
echo
echo "--- staged diff stat ---"
git diff --cached --stat
git commit -m "Merge branch 'move-to-stanford'"
echo "--- final log/status ---"
git log --oneline --decorate --graph -5
git status
EOF
